product.name: 4-Strip RGB LED Car Interior Lights
product.shortDescription: Four RGB LED strips with 48 LEDs total. Control colors from your phone with the app or with the included remote. Powered by USB.
description: Light up your car's interior with four RGB LED strips, 48 LEDs in total.
Change colors and effects from the smartphone app, or use the remote control. The kit plugs into a USB port for power.
features: Smart app control from your phone
product.imageAlt: Car interior lit in red, purple and blue by four RGB LED strips, shown with the strips, USB control box and phone app
